Scripts.Name: Nullx11 - Rosu Mania
Scripts.Description: Note tracking, configurable hit/hold timing, input release and gameplay rescan. Autoplay starts off.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; Nullx11 adaptation; original Yvetzal / Wyrizon / Infernum. Not for resale.

Scripts.Name: Nullx11 - hussvalley
Scripts.Description: Runner routing, catcher assistance, progression tools and live status. Automation starts off; configurable per feature.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; Nullx11 adaptation; original Wyrizon and Yvetzal Team.

Scripts.Name: Nullx11 - +1 loot to forge
Scripts.Description: Forge, gear, pets, stages, tower, rewards and session tools on the full shared +1 UI. Bounded workers; automation starts off.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; Nullx11 adaptation; original xDTaraZ controller and UI.

Scripts.Name: Nullx11 - Steal An Egg
Scripts.Description: Egg farming, inventory, event, navigation and character tools from the supplied source. All jobs start off. Game-module compatibility is checked before startup.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; adapted from Henrik / xyzhenrik (Silence). Original provenance retained.

Scripts.Name: stealabrainrot
Scripts.Description: Supplied Chilli controller adapted to Nullx11 controls: stealer, helper, player, ESP and server tools. Automation starts off; required game modules are checked first.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; adapted from user-supplied recovered Chilli source; original attribution retained.

Scripts.Name: TTK Testing
Scripts.Description: Merc hitbox visuals, centered aim, guarded weapon controls and explicit discovery. Features start off; Drawing overlays require executor support.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; adapted from user-supplied TTK source (original author unspecified).

Scripts.Name: +1 Money per Click
Scripts.Description: Worlds 1–4 smart Rebirth/Cash routing, money, evolution and 16 egg choices. Default-off jobs, exclusive movement modes and bounded requests.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; original smart-farming source by VoidScripts / VoidScriptsDK.

Scripts.Name: StealAnEgg-CHILI
Scripts.Description: Recovered core from partial Chilli SAE source: nearby carry, opt-in saved-point return, egg labels and basic progression. Default off. VM-dependent features remain unavailable.
Scripts.Author: Developed by Gab; recovered-core adaptation of user-supplied Chilli SAE source; original authorship retained.
